children: Bradley S. Jacobs Plans $1B CKX Lands Deal with 10.3% Deemed Stake

Bradley S. Jacobs, through Jacobs Private Equity II, LLC, reported a 10.3% stake in CKX LANDS, INC. for disclosure purposes, based on a voting agreement covering shares held by CKX chairman W. Gray Stream. Jacobs and Stream signed the agreement on November 8, 2026, and Jacobs filed the Schedule 13D on November 16. The agreement supports a proposed $1 billion investment that would give Jacobs’ firm control of CKX Lands and make Jacobs its chairman and chief executive.

Jacobs Private Equity II and other investors agreed to invest $1 billion in CKX Lands, subject to stockholder approval, antitrust clearance and other closing conditions. After the deal closes, Jacobs Private Equity II will control the company, and Jacobs will lead it as chairman and chief executive. The investors would own about 99.78% of CKX Lands on an as-converted basis, before warrant exercises.

Jacobs plans to choose the board’s size and designate its directors and committees, and he can decide the company’s new name and trading symbol. The agreement also calls for CKX Lands to pursue growth, including through acquisitions and new stock or debt offerings. Stream agreed to vote for the deal and related proposals and, subject to exceptions, not to transfer his shares while the support agreement remains in effect.

Jacobs Private Equity II, LLC is an investment vehicle formed to make equity investments in companies. Bradley S. Jacobs serves as its managing member. He also serves as chairman and chief executive of QXO, Inc., a building products distributor.
